news.title: Quentin Grimes scores 47, forces OT with 10th 3-pointer as Lakers rally past Hornets 118-114
news.text: — Quentin Grimes scored a career-high 47 points and forced overtime on his 10th 3-pointer with 1.7 seconds left in regulation before the Los Angeles Lakers finished off their ninth consecutive victory, 118-114 over the Charlotte Hornets on Tuesday night.
